candidates.title: Opportunities in Pulsed Magnetic Fusion Energy
candidates.notes: Accessible HTML on arxiv. Discusses cost requirements for pulsed magnetic fusion drivers including SFS Z-pinch. Mentions cost must decrease 5–10x and component lifetimes increase ~1000x for commercial Hz-rate operation. References $4/J for refurbished Sandia Z machine and ~$11/J for Linear Transformer Drivers. Calls for cost optimization models analogous to tokamak tools.
